meta.title: TAN Verification: refused for a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role on the specified Enterprise tenant.
Use TAN Verification to verify a vendor TAN via API and observe whether the action is refused or unavailable.
Repeat the TAN Verification attempt as an MDM / Master Data Team user and compare availability or refusal.
Record tenant RBAC configuration when access is granted to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role on the specified Enterprise tenant.; Use TAN Verification to verify a vendor TAN via API and observe whether the action is refused or unavailable.; Repeat the TAN Verification attempt as an MDM / Master Data Team user and compare availability or refusal.; Record tenant RBAC configuration when access is granted to additional roles.

args.need: sign in as both the non-MDM user and the MDM / Master Data Team user on the specified Enterprise tenant, attempt TAN Verification for a vendor via API in each session, and record whether the action is refused or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot sign in as role-specific users or perform TAN Verification, so the tester must execute and compare both role scenarios.
